source.title: Operation and Maintenance Manual — 1104D (Mech) Industrial Engine, NK (Engine), NL (Engine), NM (Engine)

entries.parameter: No oil pressure / maximum coolant temperature exceeded
entries.meaning: NOTICE: if no oil pressure is indicated, STOP the engine; if the maximum coolant temperature is exceeded, STOP the engine. Engine damage can result.

entries.parameter: Typical engine oil pressure at rated rpm
entries.conditions: SAE10W30 oil, at rated rpm. Lower pressure is normal at low idle.
entries.meaning: Typical range only. It is NOT a minimum or a trip setting and is never used as the 'OEM minimum oil pressure'.

entries.parameter: Jacket water coolant temperature, maximum allowable
entries.conditions: Maximum allowable. Typical range 71–96 °C. Maximum allowable 110 °C with the pressurised cooling system at 48 kPa (7 psi). The reading should never exceed the boiling point for the pressurised system in use.
entries.meaning: Published engine maximum, not the controller's high-coolant-temperature alarm setting. The alarm setting for the set must still be confirmed and entered.
Never exceed the high idle rpm: overspeeding can seriously damage the engine. The manual does not state the high idle figure here; it depends on the engine rating.

gaps: This is the industrial-engine manual. Generator (ElectropaK) builds of the 1104 may have their own manual; these entries apply only to the 1104D (Mech) Industrial Engine NK/NL/NM named.
No minimum oil pressure or oil-pressure trip value is given in the section read: the low-oil-pressure STOP stays on the figure the technician enters (per OEM manual — NOT VERIFIED).
